title: Power Apps: model-driven apps as Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: Hold: the claim that none of these settings can be scripted overlooks the documented Dataverse API for app-setting overrides. The roadmap facts, feature limitations and cited control paths are supported, although other Microsoft pages give conflicting control labels and setup steps.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API for the app participation setting, so none of the listed settings can be scripted.
claims.quote:
Creates or updates app/organization level override.
AppUniqueName: Model-driven app unique name (Optional).
SettingName: Setting definition unique name (Required).
Value: Overridden value that needs to be set (Required).
claims.fix: Replace controls[4].api with kind 'rest', call 'POST <organization-url>/api/data/v9.2/SaveSettingValue; Content-Type: application/json; body: {"AppUniqueName":"<app-unique-name>","SettingName":"m365copilotmodelappenabled","Value":"<setting-value>"}', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/savesettingvalue. Keep the value as a placeholder, not a guessed On/Off encoding. The feature user page names this setting; https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/clientapi/get-update-setting-value-using-code documents setting APIs and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/use-web-api-actions documents POST invocation. Replace the final Governance controls sentence with: 'Dataverse documents SaveSettingValue for app-setting overrides; no automation equivalent was found for the other listed settings in November 2026.'
